_honesty_note: Full Aristotle proof corpus (every PROVED registry theorem, source read from its recorded source.file). Each proof carries a `tier`: AXLE_VERIFIED_AXIOM_CLEAN = AXLE cloud-compiled AND axiom-audited kernel-clean AND sorry-free; AXLE_VERIFIED = AXLE-compiled but not (yet) axiom-clean; ARISTOTLE_CANDIDATE = no independent AXLE verdict. Tiers reflect the registry's recorded AXLE cloud verification (env-stamped); full offline `lake` re-compilation is tracked separately and is not asserted here. Quarantined (held/flagged) proofs are never shown axiom-clean, only AXLE_VERIFIED.
naming_caveat: Some targets are aspirational labels (e.g. *.TwinPrimeConjecture proves a reduction, not the conjecture). The binding content is the `statement`.

tiers_legend.AXLE_VERIFIED: AXLE compiled; axiom audit not (yet) clean/available.
tiers_legend.ARISTOTLE_CANDIDATE: Aristotle self-reported only; NOT independently verified.
